headline.title: 卢拉赢得巴西总统第四任期，击败极右翼候选人博索纳罗
headline.summary: 巴西左翼总统卢拉在决选中击败极右翼参议员弗拉维奥·博索纳罗，赢得第四个非连续任期，称这是对否认主义的失败。
headline.title_en: Lula wins fourth term as Brazil president after historic upset
headline.summary_en: Brazil’s leftist President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has won a fourth non-consecutive term, defeating far-right Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in a historic comeback and calling the result a defeat for denialism.
